open_questions.why_it_matters: Format decisions (short-form, long-form, reels, etc.) drive production timeline, budget scope, and platform strategy.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πόσα videos και σε ποιες μορφές (π.χ. 15s reels, TikTok, YouTube shorts, long-form)? Και ποια είναι τα social channels προτεραιότητα;

open_questions.gap: Figure stated as 'κάπου στα ογδόντα, μπορεί ογδόντα πέντε' (80–85) with no unit, currency, or scope clarification. ANNA explicitly states this excludes media spend.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Budget amount in euros, thousands, or other unit; and separation of production vs. media spend determines feasibility of deliverables and platform investment.
